description: Four independent DC blocking high pass filters, for keeping direct current out of a signal. The filters follow the current sample rate, and one menu setting fixes the corner frequency of all four

inputs.text: The signal into one of the four filters

outputs.text: That filter's signal with its direct current removed

menu: Set to 5Hz, Set to 10Hz, Set to 15Hz, Set to 20Hz, Set to 25Hz and Set to 30Hz — pick the high pass corner frequency used by all four filters
